Definition: The TASK skill invocation whose INIT-TASK dispatch contract is defined by the dbm-publish brief schema.
Publication root or package root used as the task scope.
The write-boundary list constrained to the package snapshot subtree and package-level readiness artifacts.
The immutable package snapshot parent or package root under _Publication/DBM/package/.
Runtime override selecting FULL_ENGINEERING_DBM or DBM_DIGEST; it defaults to FULL_ENGINEERING_DBM.
Publication output mode that requires Publication_Content_Adequacy.md and cannot be READY without a PASS or PASS_WITH_NOTES adequacy verdict.
Digest publication mode that must be explicitly selected and cannot satisfy full-DBM readiness unless not accepted as a governing full DBM.
The content adequacy artifact required for FULL_ENGINEERING_DBM mode and assembled from section QA outputs, optional smoke-test signals, and direct package review.
The readiness artifact that states classification and summarizes tool status, completeness, adequacy, QA burden, coverage gaps, open items, and rerun need.
The rerun guidance CSV required when readiness is not READY, with columns for section, reason, blocking level, finding, action, and notes.
The open-items artifact containing Human Authority Rulings, Engineering TBDs, and Decomposition Gaps tables.
A deterministic assembly artifact emitted in the package snapshot for knowledge coverage reporting.
Validation that compares source-fidelity-critical values against admitted reference and provenance material and accounts for accepted supersession-governed divergences.
A frozen publication-manifest input that triggers validate_source_supersession.py when admitted.
Runtime override controlling whether hypergraph evidence is admitted as NONE, AUXILIARY_PLANNING, AUXILIARY_QA, or AUXILIARY_PLANNING_AND_QA.
Runtime override whose BLOCKED value prevents hypergraph QA sub-checks from running.
Runtime override determining whether hypergraph QA blockers are advisory or binding on package readiness.
A hypergraph-derived structural concern that does not block readiness by default.
A hypergraph-derived structural concern classified as blocking.
Default hypergraph QA binding policy where HYPERGRAPH_QA_BLOCKER findings are reported but do not change readiness classification.
Hypergraph QA binding policy where HYPERGRAPH_QA_BLOCKER findings escalate readiness classification to BLOCKED.
Section-matrix field whose values preserve material table-treatment distinctions.
Package Verdict field that records PASS, PASS_WITH_NOTES, or BLOCKED for content adequacy.
Publication_Content_Adequacy.md section with one row per required section and fields for section adequacy assessment.
Publication_Content_Adequacy.md section for design-basis tables only, excluding trace, index, provenance, and reference tables.
Publication_Content_Adequacy.md section limited to issues requiring human judgment.
A knowledge type whose zero material body contribution must be summarized as a knowledge-coverage gap.
Default finding for a PRIMARY KTY with zero material body contribution; non-blocking unless escalated.
Human-owned disposition artifact for post-authoring concordance candidate findings.
Deterministic publication helper for package assembly, completeness checks, trace appendix, manifest, package QA, knowledge coverage, and open-items inventory.
Deterministic publication helper for source/reference-fidelity validation of supersession-governed divergences.
